citations.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社, 2012
citations.field: PDF p. 658; printed p. 645; 米 entry continuation; scan inspected
citations.text: The entry describes 米 as a pictograph resembling scattered grains: small marks lie above and below a horizontal stroke, later changing into longer strokes and a cross-like form. It gives the original sense as seeds of grain crops with their husks removed, then notes later broader use for shelled kernels such as 花生米, embroidered patterns resembling grains, and a measure meaning a small amount. The printed page and passage were checked against the supplied scan; the headword 米 is at the bottom of PDF p. 657 (printed p. 644), and the explanation continues at the top of p. 658. No OCR correction was identified in the inspected passage.
